description: This header file declares the TriggerStimulatorHelper class and related functions for simulating trigger signals based on trigger shapes in a controller firmware development project.

classes.name: TriggerStimulatorHelper
classes.description: A helper class responsible for generating synthetic shaft signals for triggering purposes based on trigger shapes, providing methods to find synchronization points and feed simulated trigger events.

methods.name: findTriggerSyncPoint
methods.description: Finds the trigger synchronization point based on specified trigger shape and state.

methods.name: assertSyncPositionAndSetDutyCycle
methods.description: Asserts the synchronization position and sets the duty cycle based on the trigger index, trigger shape, and state.

methods.name: feedSimulatedEvent
methods.description: Feeds the next simulated trigger event to observe how the trigger state reacts.
